profileDigest: Independent developer. Projects: orbit-notes (TypeScript, React, sync engine), tidepool (Python, DuckDB), paper-lantern (Node, Markdown), fieldkit (Node CLI), agent-playbook. Agents: Claude, Codex, Copilot, DeepSeek web, OpenCode. Wants local-first tools with small setup.

findings.title: tracelight: a trace viewer for agent runs
findings.summary: Turns agent transcripts into a timeline of steps, tool calls and waits, with a flame view for slow runs.
findings.whatsNew: Adds import for plain JSONL transcripts.

reasoning.cost: Half a day to export transcripts in its format.

risks.detail: Transcripts can hold file paths; keep the viewer local.

reasoning.counter: Most slow runs are already obvious from the run log.
reasoning.overlap: Agent Monitor covers live sessions; tracelight covers finished ones.

evidence.claim: Turns agent transcripts into a timeline of steps, tool calls and waits, with a flame view for slow runs
evidence.how: Read the README and the latest release notes
evidence.quote: Adds import for plain JSONL transcripts.

evidence.claim: It would not help this setup
evidence.how: Compared with the tools HQ already runs
evidence.quote: Agent Monitor covers live sessions; tracelight covers finished ones.

steps: Read what tracelight does and how it runs.
